review_scope: Other-author source derivation, materialize adapter and canonical job lifecycle
Root dedicated TABLE read guard and shared reader integration
Root dataset/read/write registrations and management CLI
Relevant source/adapter/job/read-guard/typed-write pure test assertions, inspected without execution
independence_exclusions: Reviewer-authored EquityStyleMonthly DTO, key, dataset, mapper, read repository and write port are not claimed as independently reviewed implementations
Reviewer-authored source-contract artifact is cited only as mapping investigation basis

checks.detail: Fixed 16 legacy codes and full 14 ordered upstream fields are frozen; literal bounded SQL uses validated identifiers and LocalDate only. Twelve-month/6200-row budgets, exact UTC carriers, finite nullable values, before/after source physical snapshots and full raw-value fingerprint are enforced. Duplicate code/date keys are refused; last non-null by strictly ordered source date preserves legacy pivot semantics. Absolute returns retain percent and spreads percentage points, without rescaling.

All modes end before the logical-date month. INCREMENTAL requires every month from bootstrap through to with all 16 source return cells finite and non-null. Legacy nullable derivation remains available for bounded historical MATERIALIZE; it is not silently promoted to complete incremental coverage.

All-date conflict exclusion protects the shared table while fetch remains bounded. One actual page is submitted through the shared runner. After its consumer returns, complete bootstrap-to-end actual target values, source identity/raw hash and target WAL/frontier stability are rechecked before fetch completes and the owning run can become VERIFIED. RECONCILE's port performs SELECT verification rather than sender publication.

A checkpoint candidate must match actual job/version/target/bootstrap, its single verified slice, nested page/source fingerprints, and complete frozen prefix evidence. Only closed contiguous 16-return prefixes are eligible, including eligible verified history from another mode. Actual old-prefix target values are read again; a changed old-prefix source raw hash, derived values or physical identity marks revision and restarts from bootstrap. Unchanged prefix retains bounded overlap rather than skipping all prefix verification.

Run/resume uses frozen requests and the canonical SQLite runner; changed frozen sources are rejected rather than silently replanned. Plan and prepared writes refuse retained shared-dataset leases or pending submissions/runs. Cancel is durable management; decorative target snapshot errors preserve the actual persisted run result and run ID.

Recovery requires the original same-instance publication object and actual sender termination, exact frozen identity, full current source/target parity, stable WAL and its retained all-date in-doubt lease. Exactly one original submitted page is required. A partially committed VERIFIED slice/run remains reentrant. ATTEMPT RUNNING or IN_DOUBT can complete only after the full proof and verified slice via existing ledger guards. Source/target/stop proof is repeated after transitions before releasing exclusion. A new JVM cannot invent original writer-stop proof and must retain uncertainty.

Dedicated equity-style policy requires the exact registered 30-field TABLE definition, first-of-month LocalDate key/range, at most 12 months and page size 12 before JDBC. It verifies ordered schema, designated/upsert month, YEAR/WAL/DEDUP/no-MV flags and settled physical/WAL frontiers. Actual ID/directory/transaction/sequence vectors bind cursors and reads before/after; every metadata SQL has its own finite timeout and row cap.

Both read and prepare invoke the dedicated early D103 guard. Configured typed bindings use the explicit mapper and no caller-supplied snapshot substitute; actual physical metadata controls the cursor version. The existing source dependency definition remains explicit.

D103 mapper and requireBatch run before target resolution and durable group planning, so over-12-row batches, duplicate/malformed keys and all-null timestamp-only ILP rows fail before SUBMITTED. Typed INGEST subsequently uses the same isolated port, exact codec and shared prepared runner; no independent formal writer is introduced. Unlike D101 delegated assertions, D103 typed writes accept explicitly supplied valid 30-field values within this isolated contract.

Registered finite plan/run/status/cancel/resume/reconcile/install command dispatch uses exact supported options and requires explicit bounded dates/mode as applicable. Installation remains a separate management operation. Incomplete run outcomes retain their printed persisted result and cause command failure rather than claiming verified completion. D022 upstream job references use the actual owner constants.

resolved_findings.issue: Incremental checkpoint could cross a missing month or nullable required-code month
resolved_findings.resolution: Closed-month and exact contiguous all-16-source-return coverage enforced at plan/preflight and checkpoint eligibility

resolved_findings.issue: Typed WRITE over-budget/all-null payload could be rejected only after SUBMITTED
resolved_findings.resolution: Root D103 mapper/requireBatch validation added before target resolution and group planning

resolved_findings.issue: Reconciliation could be stuck after partial slice/run verification commits
resolved_findings.resolution: Same-instance exact-proof reconciliation is reentrant for verified records with retained in-doubt lease, with fresh frontier checks before release

resolved_findings.issue: Checkpoint page fingerprint omitted the inner source/raw hash
resolved_findings.resolution: Nested hash now matches the actual adapter page fingerprint and verifies FETCHED plus original slice proof

resolved_findings.issue: Attempt IN_DOUBT transaction failure could leave durable ATTEMPT RUNNING
resolved_findings.resolution: Existing legal RUNNING-to-VERIFIED attempt transition is admitted only after original submitted slice and full source/target/stop proof; new real SQLite regression covers this state

limitations: This record is static review only; it does not claim compilation, test success, actual publication, database acceptance or provider readiness.
Twenty-second SQL/visibility bounds are per operation and runner boundaries; they are not a new hard total-work deadline. The job timeout remains the existing five-minute contract.

Unknown publication from another JVM cannot be cleared by a caller boolean or automatically resent. Durable uncertainty and shared-table exclusion remain until real original stopped-writer evidence is available.
Global source history, provider universe completeness, historical point-in-time correctness, formal writer promotion and application caller cutover are outside this review.
Legacy nullable MATERIALIZE output and complete INCREMENTAL coverage have distinct admissibility rules. Only complete closed verified prefixes can become checkpoint candidates.
An unchanged incremental prefix can resend its bounded overlap month; all-date exclusion does not expand its source or row budget.
Root actual missing-only setup requires its separate durable CREATE intent/claim evidence; this static review does not authorize a retry of unknown DDL.
Own DTO/mapper/repository/port implementation must be reviewed by another author and actual finite acceptance must be executed by the root coordinator.
